root_idea.summary: The root has two principal semantic orientations: making an assertion without certainty, and undertaking responsibility or guarantee.
root_idea.development: The first orientation develops into doubtful report, supposition, false assertion, and related expressions; the second develops into guaranteeing, responsibility, leadership, and rank.

senses.definition: To assert, say, or report a claim, characteristically one regarded as doubtful or false.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, the verb introduces or attributes claims presented in a condemnatory context; the emphasis is on the asserted content rather than on a neutral act of speaking.

senses.definition: To hold or believe that something is the case.
senses.usage_conditions: This Quranic use expresses a belief or conviction, specifically in the statement attributed to those who deny resurrection.

senses.definition: A guarantor; one responsible or answerable for something.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic construction assigns responsibility or guarantee for an object or matter; the term may be understood through the branch of suretyship or responsibility.

senses.definition: An assertion or professed claim, especially one suspected of falsehood.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression بِزَعْمِهِمْ, the noun denotes an asserted explanation or claim presented with blameworthy or doubtful status.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To describe someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separately attested classical transitive use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To promise.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A classical use illustrated by an assertion understood as a promise.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An opinion or supposition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions such as فِي زَعْمِي, “in my opinion.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: To think or suppose someone to be a certain way.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with a personal object in the sense of regarding or supposing that person to possess a specified quality.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bear witness or testify.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A classical use distinct from merely reporting an assertion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To guarantee, undertake responsibility for, or stand surety for something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A classical verb construction with بِهِ; the Quranic guarantor noun is treated separately above.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become chief, master, prince, or spokesman of a people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A classical leadership use, including becoming the representative speaker of a group.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To jostle or compete with another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form III lexical variant related to زاحم.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone responsible, answerable, or surety for something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV causative use, especially with property or another specified matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone covet or eagerly desire something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV causative use corresponding to inducing eager desire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To obey the chief or leader.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A classical use referring to obedience to a زَعِيم.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become possible, said of an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive classical use applied to a matter or affair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To begin to become good, pleasant, or fit to drink, said of milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized classical use applied to milk.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be thought to have fat in the hump, said of a she-camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use attributed in the lexical evidence to a young or full-grown she-camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put forth its first plants or herbage, said of the earth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized intransitive use applied to land; the source reports a possible textual uncertainty about the form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To speak falsely or fabricate assertions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form V use equated with false speaking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To exchange doubtful assertions or stories and differ over them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form VI reciprocal use for disputing or discoursing about reports in which little confidence is placed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become mutually responsible for one another, and hence to league together or aid one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal responsibility and alliance construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pride, pretension, or vain self-assertion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A later or vulgar use explained as arising from false or vain assertion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Responsibility, answerableness, or suretyship.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun associated with the construction زَعَمَ بِهِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Succulent or gravy-laden, said of roasted meat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to meat that is rich in grease, gravy, or juice and quickly drips over the fire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An assertion or stated claim; in a conventional rejection formula, an assertion judged untrue.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural may denote stories or assertions in which no confidence is placed; the form also occurs in formulas rejecting another person's statement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Mendacious; also, in a contrary reported use, veracious.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical evidence explicitly records these two opposite values.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel or sheep or goat whose fatness is uncertain and is tested by touch.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized feminine epithet for an animal whose fatness is in question.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having little fat; also reported in the contrary sense, having much fat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The evidence explicitly records both opposite applications; related feminine forms are also reported.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Impotent or ineffective in speech.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized descriptive use, also reported for زُعْمُومٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A chief, lord, master, prince, or spokesman of a people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A leadership noun; the spokesman is so called because he speaks on behalf of the group.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Described or characterized.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct adjectival use equivalent to مَوْصُوفٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: High or elevated rank, nobility, chiefdom, lordship, mastery, or princedom.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A classical abstract noun for elevated status or leadership.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A weapon or weapons.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized lexical use, particularly in the cited inheritance context.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A coat of mail or coats of mail.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized military use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The chief's share of spoil.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized inheritance or distribution term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The best or greater portion of property in an inheritance or similar division.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use for the superior portion of an estate or property.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An animal of the ox kind, probably a wild bovine.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized zoological noun equivalent to بَقَرَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing or affair in which no confidence is placed; a disputed or untenable assertion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used of saying what is not right or asserting what is impossible.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing coveted or eagerly desired.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun equivalent to مَطْمَعٌ, “an object of desire.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: Something that induces coveting or eager desire.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression أَمْرٌ مُزْعِمٌ, an affair that makes one desire eagerly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A serpent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized zoological noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To covet or eagerly desire.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A classical use of زَعِمَ expressing eager desire; it may be used with فِي for the desired object.

cautions: The Quranic زَعِيمٌ occurrences are represented in the responsibility or guarantee sense; the separately attested chief or spokesman sense is classical but not assigned to those Quran occurrences.
The Mufradat discussion records an alternative derivational interpretation of زَعِيمٌ through assertion as well as through guarantee; the contextual Quranic sense remains responsibility or guarantee.
Lane's historical Quran citation notation has not been converted into a modern verse location where an independently secure QAC location was unavailable.
